notes: Built from news + aggregator articles (goroli.com, dhakabusroute.com; Dhaka Tribune & Daily Star returned HTTP 403 but their content was recovered via WebSearch). Route 22's ordered stop sequence is well-evidenced (Ghatarchar->Staff Quarter/Demra); routes 21 (pilot, Ghatarchar->Kanchpur/Narayanganj) and 26 (Ghatarchar->Kadamtoli) sequences are reconstructed from news descriptions and vary between sources. NO published clock times or headway exist in the sources — Dhaka Nagar Paribahan runs roughly 06:00–22:00 daily; times are SYNTHESIZED at a representative 30-min headway (one representative trip per direction generated here) with ~4 min inter-stop dwell. Coordinates geocoded by neighborhood name from public lat/long references (latlong.net, Wikipedia, findlatitudeandlongitude, mapcarta) — they are area centroids, not exact stop poles; ~70 physical stops were reportedly built but only named-sequence stops are included (no invented stops). route_type=3 (bus). Confidence 0.45: stop sequences moderately faithful, but all times are estimated and coordinates are approximate.
